d: Tivoli Hotels & Resorts is a collection of luxury hotels and resorts set in idyllic beaches and cosmopolitan locations, from iconic destinations in Europe to the Middle East, and from Brazil to Asia. We are timeless, dedicated, and distinctive — evoking a time when hotel stays were grand experiences and travel meant life slowed down for a while.

Founded in 1933, Tivoli’s long-standing heritage is built on extraordinary service, authentic local experiences, and a genuine dedication to the art of hospitality. If you share a passion for making every guest feel they have arrived somewhere truly special, Tivoli is where your story belongs.

The AC Technician (HVAC) is responsible for the installation, inspection, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of air conditioning, ventilation, and refrigeration systems throughout the hotel. The role ensures that all HVAC equipment operates efficiently and safely to maintain a comfortable environment for guests and team members in accordance with Tivoli Hotels & Resorts' operational and safety standards.
Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on air conditioning, heating, ventilation, and refrigeration systems throughout the hotel.
Inspect, troubleshoot, and repair HVAC equipment, including split units, package units, chilled water systems, fan coil units (FCUs), air handling units (AHUs), and exhaust fans.
Monitor and maintain temperature, humidity, and air quality levels in guest rooms, public areas, offices, and back-of-house facilities.
Diagnose and resolve mechanical, electrical, and refrigeration-related faults to minimize equipment downtime.
Conduct routine inspections of HVAC systems to identify potential issues and ensure optimal performance.
Clean and replace air filters, coils, belts, and other HVAC components as required.
Monitor refrigerant levels, detect leaks, and carry out necessary repairs in accordance with safety and environmental regulations.
Respond promptly to guest room maintenance requests and HVAC-related emergencies.
Coordinate with the Engineering Supervisor to schedule preventive maintenance and major repairs.
Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, equipment inspections, repairs, and spare parts usage.
Ensure proper handling and maintenance of HVAC tools, equipment, and materials.
Follow hotel policies, health and safety procedures, and energy conservation practices.
Assist other Engineering team members with general maintenance duties when required.
Maintain cleanliness and organization of mechanical rooms, workshops, and work areas.
Report major equipment defects, safety hazards, and maintenance concerns to the Engineering Supervisor.
q: Diploma or technical certification in Air Conditioning, Refrigeration, HVAC Technology, or a related technical field.
Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in HVAC maintenance, preferably within the hospitality industry.
Strong knowledge of air conditioning, refrigeration, and ventilation systems.
Experience in maintaining FCUs, AHUs, chillers, split units, and other HVAC equipment.
Basic knowledge of electrical systems, mechanical components, and HVAC control systems.
Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, and equipment manuals.
Familiarity with preventive maintenance procedures and troubleshooting techniques.
Good understanding of occupational health and safety regulations.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Flexibility to work shifts, weekends, and respond to emergency maintenance requirements.
Commitment to quality and operational efficiency

Minimum of 5 years of hands-on technical support experience in IT infrastructure, service desk, data center operations, server support, or a related environment, with exposure to both first- and second-level support activities.

Ability to perform routine checks, follow technical procedures, complete standard operational tasks accurately, and carry out approved corrective actions within defined support boundaries.
Familiarity with Windows desktop support, basic Linux concepts, and standard troubleshooting methods.
Competent in printer setup, configuration, and troubleshooting across networked environments.
Familiarity with data center operations, monitoring tools, server health checks, basic infrastructure management, and escalation procedures.

Ability to use diagnostic utilities and support tools to identify, record, troubleshoot, and resolve common Level 1 and Level 2 technical issues, or escalate appropriately when specialist support is required.
Experience with E-Fax, enterprise SMS platforms, mobile device support, or similar end-user technology services will be an advantage.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical issues clearly and professionally to users.
Customer-focused mindset with a disciplined approach to incident handling, service request fulfilment, and follow-up.
Ability to work independently, follow instructions, and collaborate effectively with Engineers, Service Desk teams, Data Center colleagues, and other ICT support groups.
Organized, reliable, and detail-oriented, with good documentation practice and commitment to operational procedures.
Willingness to work in shifts, standby, or on-call arrangements when required.
Technical Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field.
r: To provide Level 1 and Level 2 technical support as part of the Data Center team for QatarEnergy’s infrastructure and end-user technology services. The role includes handling incidents and service requests, performing routine operational tasks, troubleshooting and resolving common technical issues, monitoring data center and server infrastructure, supporting approved changes, and escalating complex issues in accordance with established procedures. The position contributes to reliable day-to-day IT operations across QatarEnergy sites, including support for Active Directory, Microsoft 365, SCCM, printers, mobile devices, server monitoring, documentation, and IT inventory activities.

Provide Level 1 and Level 2 support for infrastructure and end-user technology services as part of the Data Center team, ensuring timely response to incidents and service requests across QatarEnergy sites.
Perform routine user administration and support tasks related to Active Directory, Microsoft 365, SCCM, printers, mobile devices, and other approved IT services.

Troubleshoot and resolve Level 1 and Level 2 technical issues where within the role scope; document actions taken and escalate complex, recurring, or specialist issues to Engineers or relevant support teams.

Carry out standard service request fulfilment activities, including account support, access requests, software deployment support, device configuration, operational checks, and approved first- and second-level support tasks.

Monitor data center infrastructure, servers, services, and health dashboards; investigate initial alerts, take approved corrective actions where applicable, and escalate anomalies or service degradation in line with procedures.
Support patching, vulnerability remediation, cybersecurity controls, and emergency procedures under approved guidance, including execution of assigned Level 1 and Level 2 operational activities.
Assist Engineers during infrastructure upgrades, project activities, testing, and deployment tasks as required.
Maintain accurate operational records, technical documentation, standard checklists, and IT inventory information.
Provide courteous and clear communication to users, ensuring incidents and requests are handled professionally and in line with service expectations.
Support QatarEnergy applications on smartphones and tablets, including basic configuration, troubleshooting, and user assistance.
Participate in shift, standby, or on-call support arrangements when required to maintain continuity of IT services.
